title: A brief only covers what's remembered
text: Memory of your last one. Every conversation starts from zero. So, the instinct is to just brief it. Paste in everything you think matters and hope that covers it. text: It. Instead of trusting what you remember to say, Claude asks the same fixed questions every time, client, matter type, jurisdiction, conflicts, scope. Watch the anchor, jurisdiction. title: Asked, not assumed
text: It directly and jurisdiction gets an answer even when nobody thought to volunteer. The fixed question catches what the free brief missed. But, answering once only covers this matter. title: Your turn
text: With me. Before you start a new matter with Claude, don't just paste in a summary.
